about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Ashish Kumar, a Full Stack Developer at Arsoft Technologies, where I build scalable, real-world web applications that solve actual business problems.

I completed my graduation in 2024 and have experience working on diverse projects like admin panels, analytics dashboards, and landing pages using technologies such as React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.
I'm driven by code that's clean, purposeful, and user-centered.
